title: Alternate valuation date is an ESTATE-level election
catches: AVD modeled as a free per-asset field.
notes: Six months after death, or date of disposition if earlier. All-or-nothing for the whole estate, irrevocable, and allowed only if it decreases BOTH the gross estate and the sum of estate plus GST tax. With a $15,000,000 exclusion in 2026 almost no estate files a 706 at all, so AVD data being present is itself worth confirming.
